parsed.reason: Hale returned no picks at all, even though its own notes held at least three valid, date-appropriate finds, each sourced from the venue's own or municipal page. First, Pointe-à-Callière's hours page shows regular Tue–Sun hours, holiday hours around the window, and children 0–4 free. Second, the Montréal Science Centre's visitor page lists daily opening hours. Third, the Ville de Montréal Espace pour la vie calendar shows Biodôme exhibits running through January 3, 2027. None of these are term programmes. There is no invented content and no aggregator source, but the family gets nothing they could turn up to between December 27 and 30, despite clear evidence that open venues existed. This is a complete failure to deliver.
